newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mycal says to absorb 3 real estate firms in July.
newsitem.headline: Mycal says to absorb 3 real estate firms in July.

text.p: Japanese supermarket chain operator Mycal Corp said on Wednesday that it would absorb three small real-estate companies on July 1, 1997 in an attempt to obtain high-quality real estate.
The decision was designed to decrease the company's rental payments for existing shops and to strengthen its financial health, Mycal said in a statement.
The three real estate companies are not listed.

Mycal said the three firms' shares will be exchanged for Mycal shares using a certain formula, which it said would result in a fresh issue of about 10.11 million Mycal company shares, with a face value of 50 yen per share.
The merger should raise Mycal's total assets by 3.24 billion yen to 867.01 billion yen, it added.
